debrief_script: Nice work keeping a steady speed on 107th. Two things for next time: put the phone away before you start, and come to a full stop at stop signs. The limit on 107th was estimated, but you were a bit over it too. You are making progress.
chat: Hey, nice work getting that drive in! Let's talk it through.
First, your speed on 107th was really steady. That calm control is exactly what examiners want to see.
Now the big one. On 8th Street you picked up your phone for about six seconds while moving. I get it, it's a reflex, but that's the habit I most want us to break.
Try this: set your music and directions before you pull out, then keep the phone out of reach.
At the stop sign on 107th you rolled through at about three miles an hour. Stop fully, count one, two, then go.
And 8th Street keeps catching you with hard braking, three drives now. Start easing off as soon as that light comes into view.
You held at 64, right in line with your last few drives. Keep stacking these habits and you'll be road test ready. See you next drive!
